stay_point.note: PROVISIONAL defaults. Run scripts/build_stop_candidates.py once to write stop_sensitivity.csv, inspect the dwell and spread distributions, then fix the defaults here. Stays are anchored at the first observation: every later observation must be within radius_m of it, the window must span at least dwell_seconds, and it never crosses a trajectory split or a non-accepted transition. Speed (speed_raw) is not used.

clustering.note: Deterministic DBSCAN on UTM 43N metres (spatial hash neighbour search, points processed in (latitude, longitude, stay_id) order). min_samples counts stay points.

disclosure.note: A cluster may only enter a possible aggregate summary when BOTH minima are met. Everything stays private by default.

matching.note: Distance is cluster centroid to reference geometry (metres). Route endpoints are evidence, not terminals, so they never produce matched_reference.
